name: NFC Review Stand
shortDescription: A tap-and-review stand for counters, tables, and reception desks.
description: A freestanding acrylic stand built for the counter or front desk. One tap opens your Google review page instantly — no app, no typing, no friction. Designed to sit quietly on a counter and do its job every time a customer walks past.

faqs.q: Does it work with any phone?
faqs.a: Yes, it works with all NFC-enabled Android and iPhone (iOS 14+) devices.

faqs.q: What happens if a phone doesn't support NFC?
faqs.a: Every stand includes a printed QR code as a backup, so no customer is ever left out.

name: NFC Review Card
shortDescription: A credit-card sized tap card your staff can hand to any customer.
description: A slim, pocket-friendly card in the format everyone already recognizes. Perfect for staff to hand across the counter, tuck into a bill folder, or keep at the till for a quick, personal tap.

faqs.q: Can the card be reprogrammed later?
faqs.a: Yes, the chip can be rewritten if you ever need to update the link.
With normal handling, the card comfortably lasts several years.

name: Google Review Sticker
shortDescription: A weatherproof tap-and-scan sticker for doors, counters, and windows.
description: A compact NFC and QR sticker that goes wherever a card or stand can't — glass doors, till counters, delivery boxes, or table corners. Waterproof printing keeps it looking sharp for years.

faqs.a: Yes, the printing and adhesive are both rated for outdoor and washroom-level moisture exposure.

name: NFC+QR Table Menu
shortDescription: A tap-friendly digital menu card for tables and counters.
description: Replace printed menus with a clean, tappable card that opens your live digital menu. Update prices and items anytime without reprinting a single card.

faqs.q: Can I update the menu after printing?
faqs.a: Yes — the card links to your live menu page, so items and prices can change anytime.

name: Social Media NFC Card
shortDescription: One tap opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat with your business.
description: Designed for businesses that run on WhatsApp — a single tap opens a chat window with your number already filled in, removing every step between a customer and a conversation.

faqs.q: Can it open a specific pre-typed message?
faqs.a: Yes, the message text can be customized so the chat opens with context already added.

name: Custom NFC Card
shortDescription: A single tap that opens your Instagram, or a link-in-bio of all your profiles.
description: Give customers a fast route to follow you. One tap opens your Instagram, Facebook, or a combined links page — ideal for boutiques, salons, and any brand that grows through social proof.

faqs.q: Can it link to more than one platform?
faqs.a: Yes, it can point to a single profile or a link-in-bio page listing all your platforms.
